exposure: Women with PCOS with and without pregnancy complications
outcome: Childbirth experience (measured using the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire)
cohort: 365 women with PCOS and 3604 reference women
finding: Women with PCOS had similar childbirth experiences to reference women, and while metformin use or pregnancy complications did not impact childbirth experience, obesity, long labor duration, and cesarean section were associated with lower childbirth experience scores in women with PCOS.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with lower childbirth experience scores in women with PCOS.
